etsy.title: Pace Notes Sticker, Square Left Don't Cut Rally Co Driver Decal, Motorsport Laptop Sticker, Rally Fan Gift
etsy.description:
A pace notes sticker for rally fans: square left, don't cut, with two choices in a retro window, Lift or Flat out.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• One physical kiss-cut vinyl sticker, shipped directly to you
• Available in 3×3 in and 4×4 in. That's the full print area: the sticker is cut around the window, so it is wider than it is tall and measures less than the full square
• Glossy finish, with a backing that peels away cleanly

HOW TO USE
Peel and stick on a laptop, toolbox lid kept indoors, notebook, or garage cabinet. Made for indoor use, so keep it dry.

This listing is a physical sticker, not a digital download. Thank you for supporting a small shop!
